notes: placeTower now saves the price towerPrice asked at placement as `spent`, and upgradeTower adds each upgrade's cost to it. sellValue is floor(spent/2). sellTower returns 'over' when the status is not 'playing' and 'missing' for an unknown id, changing nothing in either case. Otherwise it filters the tower out of state.towers, adds its sell value to the gold and returns null. towerPrice counts the towers still standing, so the cell is free again and the next tower of that kind is one price step cheaper.

hudKey maps s and S to 'sell'. The main.js keydown handler calls sellTower on the selected tower and clears the selection. The browser test in test/sell.test.js shows a key repeat does nothing and that a sale still goes through while paused.

The tower card grows from 54 to 69 high (one 15-pixel line) and its last line is 'Press S to sell: N gold'. test/sell.test.js checks that the card stays inside the canvas for towers in all four board corners. The only edit to test/upgrade.test.js adds the new line to the card it already pins, which the brief allows.

test/sell.test.js covers every acceptance criterion: the sell value goes 10, then 22 after one upgrade; selling frees the cell and adds the gold; on normal the next lantern costs 25 after selling, not 30; an unknown id returns 'missing'; won, lost and ready games return 'over' with nothing changed; hudKey handles both cases of S; and the card draws its last line inside the canvas.
